data.review_body:
I have ordered from SHEIN a few times, sometimes the material isn’t as advertised, poor quality.
However, I ordered two tankinis, only tried the tops on, both were too tight. So I returned the items, they only refunded one, so after going into chat customer service, they told me the hygiene pad had been removed and so they would not refund me.  I told them I hadn’t even looked at the bottoms, they told me next time pay attention to goods received but no refund.  They only refunded the cheapest tankini, it was an expensive £25 one.  I did say I wouldn’t shop with them again and they just said still no refund… I have deleted my account now, but wanted to make others aware
